_comment: Production-equivalent scale for the #615 rehearsal baseline.
Only the two tables 20261006100000 locks receive scale data:
email_address_state    ADD COLUMN is_suppressed ... STORED  (full rewrite)
email_delivery_events  DROP/ADD CHECK constraint            (full validation scan)
plus the backfill, whose cost follows events_per_address and the event-type mix.
source MUST be 'measured' before clone-build-baseline will run, AND the
generated bytes must land within byte_tolerance_pct of the measured bytes —
row counts alone do not establish equivalence, because the rewrite walks PAGES.
Fill every field from the READ-ONLY sizing query in ADR-001 section 7. byte_tolerance_pct is capped at 20.

email_address_state._comment: avg_reason_len widens the pre-#615 `reason` column; provider suppression does not exist until the migration adds it

events_per_address._comment: histogram driving the backfill: how many STATE-PRODUCING events each address has

bloat._comment: dead:live ratio PER TABLE, approximating a long-lived relation (ADR-001 6.3). The production sizing query returns n_live_tup/n_dead_tup for both affected tables, so both are configured and both are generated.
